title: throttLL'eM: Predictive GPU Throttling for Energy Efficient LLM Inference Serving
problem: LLM inference serving on GPUs consumes excessive energy while providers must simultaneously satisfy Service-Level Objectives (SLOs); static GPU frequency settings over-provision compute resources when request load is low or KV cache pressure is manageable.
motivation: Inference dominates LLM workloads and GPU power demand is a growing environmental and monetary concern, requiring dynamic power management that does not violate user-facing SLO constraints.
method: The system watches upcoming requests and predicts how much temporary storage space for computation will be needed, then uses a machine learning model to estimate how long each computational step will take. Based on these predictions, it adjusts the GPU's speed—running it fast when there's work to do and slow when it can coast—and updates these decisions after every single step. The predictions are highly accurate (R² score exceeding 0.97) with an average error of less than 1 step per second. By tuning both the GPU speed and the number of model instances running in parallel, the system cuts energy use while guaranteeing response times stay within promised limits.
key_novelty: The system predicts upcoming memory and request needs to adjust GPU speed after every computational step, cutting energy proactively instead of waiting and capping power after the system gets overloaded.
contributions: Predictive ML model for KV cache usage and batch size projection in LLM inference
Iteration-level GPU frequency and instance scaling framework respecting SLOs
Up to 43.8% energy reduction vs NVIDIA Triton server under SLO constraints

metrics.energy_or_tops_w: Up to 43.8% lower energy; at least 1.71x energy efficiency improvement under SLOs vs NVIDIA Triton server

baselines: NVIDIA Triton inference server with default GPU frequency settings
limitations: The ML prediction model is trained on specific LLM inference traces and may not generalize to all model families or serving configurations without retraining.
primary_theme: predictive GPU frequency scaling for energy-efficient LLM inference serving
